name: Ardennian
description: Ardennians were a sentient, simian-like species that were native to Ardennia. Due to their extra pair of arms and prehensile toes, the species was known for being extremely agile, nimble and quick-thinking under pressure. They were able to move about while operating multiple pieces of machinery simultaneously, thus being well-suited to careers involving the military or aviation, among other choices. Notable Ardennians include Rio Durant, who operated as a pilot and criminal with Beckett's gang, and Chio Fain, who worked as a slicer.
